statusMessage:
AssertionError: Confirmed product data-integrity defects:
  - Merchant Date of Birth shows 'Nov 1, 2008', but the client record holds '2008-11-01' (Oct 31, 2008 in Eastern time).
  - Merchant License Expiry Date shows 'Nov 1, 2027', but the client record holds '2027-11-01' (Oct 31, 2027 in Eastern time).
  - Merchant summary mismatch: source=(7, 7, 1, 8), UI=(8, 7, 1, 8)
  - Application/Deal primary merchant name mismatch: application='Michael Cotic', deal='Avery Kepler'
  - Application/Deal primary merchant email mismatch: application=None, deal='notifications@mailzyng.com'
assert not ["Merchant Date of Birth shows 'Nov 1, 2008', but the client record holds '2008-11-01' (Oct 31, 2008 in Eastern time)....very Kepler'", "Application/Deal primary merchant email mismatch: application=None, deal='notifications@mailzyng.com'"]
